card.name: Final piece of names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a proper name that is split into parts, such as the 'et' in Monet, 'ius' in Darius, 'us' in Oedipus, or 'atin' in lovastatin. It fires most on the name of the painter Monet.

modes.label: Historical and artist names
modes.description: Ending piece of a split person name, mostly Monet, but also Darius, Oedipus and Bahá'u'lláh.

modes.label: Drug names
modes.description: Ending piece of a split drug name such as lovastatin or neomycin.
